# Controls: programs that keep no view of a dead frame, which the analysis
# must accept. Every other program here must be rejected.
#
# e08: fmt.Sprint copies the error's text into a new string.
e08_errorbuf_sprint_control: accepted
# s21, s22: strings.FromUTF8 and FromUTF8Lossy copy the bytes into memory
# from the allocator (rt.StringFromBytes).
s21_fromutf8_local_bytes: accepted
s22_fromutf8lossy_local_bytes: accepted
# s23: a Builder's buffer is heap memory; the string takes a counted
# reference to it.
s23_builder_string_kept: accepted
# lv01: closures of variables outside the loop, or of the header's when the
# loop is left at once, may be kept (section 18.4).
lv01_closure_of_outer_vars_kept: accepted
# tk01: task p.Serve() takes the owned box itself (section 12.12).
tk01_task_box_method_control: accepted
